Thank you for those results; the elevated white blood cell count and lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) strongly suggest increased cell turnover. Given your weight loss and night sweats, could you tell me if you have noticed any unusual lumps or swelling in your neck or under your arms recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (specifically Hodgkin Lymphoma or Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma). The combination of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, elevated LDH, and leukocytosis is highly suggestive of a lymphoproliferative disorder.
